top_signals.title: All Eyes on Warsh as Rate-Hike Fever Spreads Across G7
top_signals.summary:
Central banks from much of the Group of Seven face a pivotal week as mounting inflation risks heap pressure on them to raise interest rates.
David Tinsley, Senior Economist for Bank of America, discusses the outlook for the US consumer and what he expects to see from the Fed's rate decision this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US 10-Year Breaches 5% as Inflation, Supply Worries Mount
top_signals.summary: An intensifying selloff in Treasuries pushed the US 10-year yield above 5% for the first time since 2023, as mounting inflation concern collided with swelling government and corporate borrowing needs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Private Credit Default Rate Hits a Record of 6.3%, Fitch Says
top_signals.summary: The default rate for a group of US private debt borrowers rose to a record in August, according to Fitch Ratings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Ministers poised to nationalise second steel firm
top_signals.summary: The government is poised to take the UK’s third-largest steelworks into public ownership, after months of talks to find a buyer broke down.
